section.title: Cool Down Activity
section.para: A squirrel runs up and down a tree.
The graph shows the height of the squirrel, \(h\) (feet), as a function of time, \(t\) (seconds).

image.alt: Piecewise graph. Horizontal axis, 0 to 8, time, seconds. Vertical axis, 0 to 16, height, feet. Graph starts at 0 comma 9, increases, deceases to 4 comma 0, increases, then flattens out at 6 comma 10.

list.item: What is the highest point the squirrel reaches?

div.para: \(t=4\) means that after 4 seconds, the squirrel is at the bottom of the tree on the ground.

list.item: Solve \(h(t)=0\). What does this solution tell you about the squirrel?

div.para: \((0,9)\) means that at the beginning, the squirrel is 9 feet high in the tree.

list.item: Find the vertical intercept of the graph. What does it tell you about the squirrel?
